name: Angelfish (Pterophyllum scalare)
description: Deep-bodied South American cichlid; the 'angelfish' substring fires both depth-band (none — fish default) and territory heuristics. Explicit territory block tunes the cichlid default to angelfish-specific values — they bond into pairs that defend a small cone around the chosen spawning surface but otherwise tolerate community tankmates. Flagged `predator` (Stage 11 fidelity pass): in the 3D sim, small community fish (neon tetras, ember tetras) accumulate fear-risk near an angelfish and dart for cover — accurate to the real tank, where adult angels will pick off nano fish.
